forms.title: SmartRecruiters OneClick apply UI (spl-* web components, open shadow DOM, 2 pages)

expect.education[degree]: oneOf:Bachelor of Science|BS|BSc|Bachelor of Science (BS)|Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

quirks: every control is a spl-* custom element with an OPEN shadow root; inputs live inside shadow DOM (nested spl-internal-form-field shadow host)
host id === inner input id; <label for> only resolves inside the shadow tree
inner change events are not composed; only input + custom spl-change reach the light DOM
Confirm your email must match Email ("Provided emails do not match.")
location autocomplete: minQueryLength 3, async 'Loading...', listbox inside shadow, typing alone does not select
phone field with country-code combobox (defaults to US) that switches country when a +<code> number is typed
Experience / Education entries via 'Add' -> inline edit form (MM/YYYY dates, current checkbox) -> Save collapses to an entry card
resume spl-dropzone (Choose a file / or drop it here); upload triggers a resume parse that prefills EMPTY name/email fields and shows a banner
'Apply with LinkedIn' provider button that must be ignored
page 1 Next saves step-1 JSON and history.pushState()s to .../screening (SPA, same document)
screening: spl-select (button combobox + listbox, option values are uuids), spl-radio-group whose spl-radio hosts are role=radio with aria-checked (no native radios), free text
privacy consent spl-checkbox with slotted label-content link
forms.reference: Public OneClick bundles at js-www.smartrecruiters.com/oneclick-ui/static (oc-* component consts/data-test attributes, spl-core-components Lit templates) and /oneclick-ui/i18n English strings, studied read-only
